Metadata.title: OpenFaithMap Admin
Metadata.description: OpenFaithMap's admin/moderator console — registration wizard, operator-approval console, congregation-admin console, moderator console.

AcceptInvitePage.heading: Has sido invitado
AcceptInvitePage.welcome: Has sido invitado a unirte como {name} ({email}). Inicia sesión con Google usando esta dirección de correo para terminar de configurar tu cuenta.
AcceptInvitePage.errorMissingToken: A este enlace de invitación le falta el token.
AcceptInvitePage.errorNotFound: Este enlace de invitación no es válido.
AcceptInvitePage.errorExpired: Este enlace de invitación ha caducado. Pide a un administrador que te envíe uno nuevo.
AcceptInvitePage.errorAlreadyAccepted: Esta invitación ya ha sido aceptada. Intenta iniciar sesión.

WhoamiPage.heading: Who am I
WhoamiPage.description: Resolved by openfaithmap-api's core.whoami() from the forwarded Google ID token — this is the M1 proof that login and token passthrough work end-to-end.

ApiKeysPage.heading: API keys
ApiKeysPage.intro: Create a scoped, revocable credential for programmatic access to the API.
ApiKeysPage.keyGenerated: API key generated. Copy it now — it won't be shown again.
ApiKeysPage.errorUnknownPermissionCode: One of the selected permissions is not valid.
ApiKeysPage.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

MyCongregationPage.heading: My congregation
MyCongregationPage.noCongregation: You don't have an approved congregation yet.

RegisterPage.heading: Register your congregation
RegisterPage.intro: Submitted requests are reviewed by a registration operator before your congregation appears on the map.
RegisterPage.errorTaxonExcluded: That tradition is not eligible for registration on OpenFaithMap.

RegisterSubmittedPage.heading: Request submitted
RegisterSubmittedPage.pendingWithName: Your registration for {name} is pending review. Status: {status}.

RegistrationsPage.heading: Registration requests
RegistrationsPage.jurisdictionSearchHint: Search by name to find a unit id to paste into an approval below, or create a new one. A jurisdiction is optional — leave the approval field blank to keep the current flat-root behavior.

ReparentPage.heading: Re-parent congregations
ReparentPage.intro: Move an already-approved congregation onto a different jurisdiction unit. This is a resumable, two-step move (add the new parent, then remove the old one) — re-submitting the same target for a congregation with a job already in progress resumes it rather than starting over.

SitePage.createIntro: Choose a slug — this is the public path your site will be reachable at. Slugs are first-come, first-served.

DocumentEditorPage.blocksHint: Full replace on save — reorder by editing the position numbers. Data is raw JSON, validated against the block type's schema.

NewVouchPage.heading: Vouch for someone
NewVouchPage.intro: Vouch that a person genuinely represents a congregation you administer.
